# WorkHub ERP & Platform Intelligence

> Enterprise Multi-Tenant Resource Planning, HRMS, Agile Task Tracking, CRM & Client Invoicing Platform powered by Axinix Populate Engine.

## Overview
WorkHub is an enterprise-grade ERP designed for unified organizational operations. It consolidates human resources, project tracking, ticket dispatching, CRM lead management, double-entry financial billing, and hardware asset lifecycle management into an ABAC-secured, policy-driven architecture.

## Platform Capabilities & Modules
- **Identity & Access Management (Users & Roles)**: Multi-tenant RBAC/ABAC dynamic policy engine, PBKDF2 password encryption, privilege escalation guards, and department/designation hierarchies.
- **Human Resources (HRMS & Attendance)**: Employee document vault, immutable career progression history, biometric punch regularization, short-duration permissions, comp-off credits, and holiday policies.
- **Agile Task & Sprint Management (Tasks)**: Scrum/Kanban boards, sprint schedules, time tracker sessions, stages, priority queues, and daily work activity logs.
- **Support & Ticketing (Tickets)**: Customer incident management, SLA tracking, participant dispatches, and bi-directional status synchronization.
- **Client Accounting & Billing (Billing)**: Quotations, order acknowledgements, tax invoices, customer collection receipts, double-entry client ledgers, and accounting period locks.
- **Customer Relationship Management (CRM)**: Sales pipeline, contact interaction logs, deals, probability forecasting, and meeting scheduling.
- **Payroll & Compensation (Payroll)**: Effective-date salary structures, batch payroll computation runs, immutable payslip ledger, and expense reimbursements.
- **Asset Management (Assets)**: Hardware inventory, vendor purchase orders, assignment lifecycles, and repair logs.

## Public Architecture & Developer Resources
- **/academy**: Interactive platform architectural academy explaining the 10-stage Populate execution pipeline, ABAC policy resolution, and domain services.
- **/documentations**: Full platform documentation, system specifications, and workflow guides.
- **/populateEngineDocumentation**: In-depth developer guide on the Populate Engine API contract (`/api/populate/:action/:model`).

## Canonical API Architecture
All entity interactions follow the unified Populate Engine API pipeline:
- `POST /api/populate/read/:model` (read with AST filter, sorting, pagination, and projection)
- `POST /api/populate/create/:model` (validated transactional creation with lifecycle hooks)
- `POST /api/populate/update/:model/:id` (atomic state updates with domain service validation)
- `POST /api/populate/delete/:model/:id` (soft-delete with lifecycle status tracking)
